column2: # 中文：在初始 ggplot 对象后用 + 加上 geom_histogram()，才开始显示按价格分箱后的计数。
# English: Adding geom_histogram() with + draws counts within price bins on the initial ggplot object.
# 中文：当前图使用默认标签；下一块再添加 labs()，演示样式说明与统计图层可以逐层构建。
# English: This plot uses default labels; the following chunk adds labs() to demonstrate separate statistical and labelling layers.
ggplot(aes(price)) + # adding another layer using the '+' symbol
geom_histogram() # Layer 2 will add the type of plot we want
